entries.title: Sign in to Google from any computer that controls your first mate
entries.body: Settings → Integrations on another computer you paired now finishes connecting Google there: Google's page opens in that computer's browser, and Infinitary passes Google's answer back to your first mate's computer, where the sign-in stays. If that computer cannot take the answer itself, Settings asks you to paste the address your browser ended on.

picture.alt: Settings, Integrations, waiting for Google, with a field for the address the browser ended on and a button to send it to Mac mini
